title: Faster Harvests
description: Remove the need to replant your crops every harvest!
body:
Auto Replant turns harvesting into one continuous motion.

Right-click any fully-grown wheat, carrot, potato, beetroot, or nether wart. The crop is harvested AND replanted in place: the seed/root stays in the ground, the produce goes straight to your inventory. No more breaking blocks, picking up seeds, and laying them back down.

## How it feels

Walk down a row of wheat right-clicking. Each tile snaps back to age 0 and you collect the grain.
Inventory full? Drops fall on the block, exactly like a normal break — nothing is lost.
Plays the normal vanilla crop-break sound, so it feels like part of the game.


## Supported crops

Wheat,
Carrots,
Potatoes,
Beetroot,
Nether Wart

Each of the two groups (overworld crops, nether wart) can be toggled independently in config.

## Compatibility

Server-side install is enough. There shouldn't be any conflicts unless there is a mod that directly interferes with planting/harvesting crops.
